content.title: 8-3-3-1. Purpose.
content.summary: The purpose of this Division is to set out the policies and special procedures for annexing property into the City limits or disconnecting property from the City. Annexation is a discretionary, legislative act.

faqs.a: The purpose of this Division is to set out the policies and special procedures for annexing property into the City limits or disconnecting property from the City. Annexation is a discretionary, legislative act. The City shall never be compelled to annex, unless otherwise required by state law, even if the requirements of Section 8-3-3-2, Annexation Requirements; State Law References, are met.
